pages.title: Working Paws
pages.text: Helpers can sort, gather and clear terrain for you.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Toss pumpkin seeds to the crow, set a hay base, gathering and item frames on container sides. Tame shrimp with tropical fish and sneak-give a sample block; supply water on land. Feed platypus redstone near clay or gelada wheat.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Carved Pumpkins protect crops from crows; seating a tame crow on hay aids recovery. These supplement, not replace, actual sorting.
